Before moving day

  • Confirm management move rules, freight lift booking, and security ID lists for truck plate and crew.
  • Declutter to reduce volume; label rooms and mark FRAGILE on electronics and glass.
  • Photograph meters and wall condition at origin; repeat at destination before furniture covers walls.
  • Check holiday traffic and end-of-month rush when picking dates.

Moving day

A crew lead coordinates with security and lift windows. Blankets and disassembly are standard for furniture; heavy items load against stable cab walls for Addis streets. Neighbors in the same tower can share mobilization—group move tips.

Frequently asked questions

How far ahead should I book? Condo and office moves in Bole, Ayat, Kazanchis, or Jemo: 1–2 weeks when possible; inter-city or large commercial jobs often need 2–4 weeks.

Are stairs and elevators included? Survey notes freight lifts, stair carries, and long gate pushes—those lines belong in the written quote, not on moving day surprises.

Extra planning notes

Share origin and destination addresses, stair count, and elevator rules when you request a quote. Keep passports, leases, and small electronics off the truck until the final walk-through. If management requires deposits for lifts or gates, pay only after you have a confirmed move window in writing.

Weather and holidays can shift traffic—buffer half a day on long cross-town legs. For inter-city or storage legs, confirm whether overnight hold or next-day unload is included in your quote line items.
